dialogue.content: (こんばんは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. Thank you for joining me today.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です。年齢、性別、ご相談をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm your counselor. Could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: こんばんは！45歳女性です。
dialogue.English: Good evening! I'm a 45-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: 失礼しました
dialogue.English: Oh, my apologies.

dialogue.content: 相談内容まででしたね、
dialogue.English: You asked about the topic of my consultation as well, right?

dialogue.content: 高校２年の娘についてです
dialogue.English: It's about my daughter, who is a sophomore in high school.

dialogue.content: ええ、娘さんのどのようなことでご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What would you like to discuss regarding your daughter?

dialogue.content: 買い物が酷く毎日何か買わないと気がすまないようです
dialogue.English: Her shopping is excessive; it seems she can't feel satisfied unless she buys something every day.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは心配ですね。毎日、どのようなものを買っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be worrying. What kind of things does she buy every day?

dialogue.content: はい、様々なものなのですがお菓子類はもちろん雑貨屋やコスメなどです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's a variety of things, like snacks, of course, as well as items from general stores and cosmetics.

dialogue.content: 雑貨やでした
dialogue.English: Sorry, I meant general stores.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。娘さんの買い物のどのようなことが心配になっていますか？
dialogue.English: I see. What aspects of your daughter's shopping are you concerned about?

dialogue.content: はい、お金の遣い過ぎなことと欲しい物はすぐ買いたくなってしまうことです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's the overspending and the urge to buy whatever she wants immediately.

dialogue.content: もちろん、高価過ぎるものは買えないのですが。
dialogue.English: Of course, she can't buy things that are too expensive.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。大事な娘さんのことなので、心配するのは当然です。
dialogue.English: I see. It's completely natural to be concerned about your precious daughter.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: お金の使いすぎと感じているとのことですが、お小遣いやアルバイトの範囲内でしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned you feel she's spending too much. Is it within her allowance or what she earns from her part-time job?

dialogue.content: そうですね。お小遣いとお年玉などを貯めていた分、またバイト代からです。
dialogue.English: Yes. It comes from her allowance, the New Year’s gift money she had saved, and her part-time job wages.

dialogue.content: しかし、ある分は全てつかいたくなってしまいます
dialogue.English: However, she ends up wanting to spend all the money she has.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お年玉等、きちんと貯めていて、とてもしっかりしていますね。その辺りはどうお考えでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. It's quite responsible of her to have saved her New Year's money. What are your thoughts on that aspect?

dialogue.content: 貯金などを伝えてもためようとしません
dialogue.English: Even when I talk to her about saving, she doesn’t try to.

dialogue.content: そうですね。その日に遣うという訳ではないのですが、連日数千円の買い物が続くと遣い過ぎだと感じてしまいます。
dialogue.English: That's right. It's not that she spends it all in one day, but when she continues to spend several thousand yen for days in a row, I feel it's excessive.

dialogue.content: 確かに、お年玉をタンス貯金でもするというのは良い点ですね！
dialogue.English: You're right, saving her New Year's money, even if it's just stashed away at home, is a positive point!

dialogue.content: イライラすると買い物したい衝動にかられるみたいです💦
dialogue.English: It seems that when she gets irritated, she's driven by the impulse to shop. 💦

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。よく娘さんのことをみていらっしゃるのですね。とてもコミニュケーションが取れていて、いいご関係だと感じます。
dialogue.English: I see. You’re really attentive to your daughter. It sounds like you communicate well and have a good relationship.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！そう言っていただけると、そうなのかな！？と思えます💦
dialogue.English: Thank you! Hearing you say that makes me think maybe that’s true. 💦

dialogue.content: ただ、買い物出来ない日は意味がない！などと怒り出すので少し買い物に依存気味なのでは？と不安になります
dialogue.English: However, on days when she can’t shop, she gets angry and says things like, ‘There’s no point to today!’ So I worry she might be somewhat dependent on shopping.

dialogue.content: とてもいいご関係かと思います。買い物の依存症にならないかとご心配なのですね？
dialogue.English: I think you have a very good relationship. You’re concerned she might develop a shopping addiction, correct?

dialogue.content: はい。精神的に不安定なところがあるのですが、不安になったり、イライラすると買い物しなきゃ…と必死になります。。
dialogue.English: Yes. She has some emotional instability, and when she feels anxious or irritated, she becomes desperate, feeling she has to go shopping…

dialogue.content: 心を安定させるために買い物に頼っているのかもしれません
dialogue.English: She might be relying on shopping to stabilize her emotions.

dialogue.content: あなたは毎日の娘さんの状況をよく把握されていると思います。感情面などもよく見れているかと思います。お子さんにとっては安心されるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I think you have a good grasp of your daughter's daily situation. You're also observing her emotional state well. That must be reassuring for your child, don't you think?

dialogue.content: そうなのでしょうか？ありがとうございます。ちゃんと見ているのなら嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: Do you think so? Thank you. I'd be happy if I am truly seeing her well.

dialogue.content: 安心できていたらいいのですが…
dialogue.English: I hope she feels secure…

dialogue.content: 高校生の娘さんなので、中学校とは違って、友達との付き合いやおしゃれなどでお金を使うこともあるかもしれません。その辺りはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Since she's a high school student, unlike in middle school, she might be spending money on socializing with friends or on fashion. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: そうですね、、娘は友達付き合いが苦手で中、高校の友人とはほとんど付き合いがないようです💦
dialogue.English: Right… My daughter isn’t good at socializing, and it seems she hardly spends time with her middle or high school friends. 💦

dialogue.content: たまに遊びに行くのは小学生の頃の友人で、たまぁに行く程度で
dialogue.English: The only person she occasionally goes out with is a friend from elementary school, and even that is just once in a while.

dialogue.content: ほとんど一人で買い物に出かけます。
dialogue.English: She mostly goes shopping by herself.

dialogue.content: そうあったんですね。娘さんは学校で頑張っているのですね。そういったところで買い物などで気持ちのバランスをとっているかもしれませんね。どう感じられますか？
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like your daughter is working hard at school. She might be using shopping to balance her feelings. How does that sound to you?

dialogue.content: そうですね。学校も行き渋るのですが頑張っているのだと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. She's reluctant to go to school, but I think she is trying her best.

dialogue.content: おっしゃる通りですね。
dialogue.English: That’s exactly right.

dialogue.content: とても、しっかりした娘さんかと思います。先をみて学校には行っている。でもストレスは買い物で発散するといった行動は自然なことかもしれません。
dialogue.English: I think she's a very responsible daughter. She goes to school with the future in mind. Releasing her stress through shopping might be a natural behavior for her.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そう解釈すればいいのですね！！
dialogue.English: I see—so it’s okay to interpret it that way!!

dialogue.content: 目から鱗です！
dialogue.English: That's a real eye-opener!

dialogue.content: たた買い物出来ないときにパニックになるのですがこの状態は依存とは言わないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: But she panics when she can't shop. Wouldn't this state be considered a dependency?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは戸惑いもあるかもしれません。どのように対応していますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That must be perplexing for you. How do you usually respond in those situations?

dialogue.content: 取り乱すので、そんな時はあまり刺激しないように少しの間は見守っています。
dialogue.English: She gets very upset, so at times like that, I try not to provoke her and just watch over her for a while.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。その後は落ち着きますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Does she calm down after that?

dialogue.content: 日によります。夜、どうしても〇〇を買いに行く！など取り乱した際や高額なものを買いたい、買ってなどと言ってくる時もあり
dialogue.English: It depends on the day. Sometimes she gets upset at night, insisting, "I have to go buy XX right now!" Other times she'll say she wants to buy something expensive, or ask me to buy it for her.

dialogue.content: そんな時は、それは出来ないよと伝えています。
dialogue.English: At those times, I tell her, “We can’t do that.”

dialogue.content: そうあったんですね。とても冷静に対応できていると感じます。あなたが娘さんの性格等、いつも見ているからこその対応ですね。
dialogue.English: I see. I feel that you are handling it very calmly. That's a response that's only possible because you're always observing your daughter's personality.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。度々あるので正直対応に疲れます😓
dialogue.English: Thank you. It happens often, so to be honest I’m tired of dealing with it. 😓

dialogue.content: そうですよね。毎日のことだとエネルギーも使いますよね。それだけ、思ってくれるお母様がいて、娘さんは幸せですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It must take a lot of energy when it's a daily occurrence. Your daughter is lucky to have a mother who cares so much about her.

dialogue.content: はい、本当にエネルギーを使います💦娘は幸せなんでしょうか？そう言っていただけると少し自信を取り戻せる気がします。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, it really does take a lot of energy. 💦 Is my daughter really lucky? Hearing you say that helps me regain a little confidence. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 買い物以外に日々の意味を見出せるようにしたいと思うのですが
dialogue.English: I'd like her to be able to find meaning in her days outside of shopping, though.

dialogue.content: 何か方法はあるでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is there any way to do that?

dialogue.content: そのようにお考えなのですね。ご一緒にお出かけはされないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So that's what you're thinking. Do you two ever go out together?

dialogue.content: 納得いく買い物が出来なかった日は、今日は何も買ってない！今日生きた意味がないとよく言います。
dialogue.English: On days when she couldn't make a satisfying purchase, she often says, "I didn't buy anything today! There was no point in living today."

dialogue.content: よく出かけます
dialogue.English: We go out often.

dialogue.content: 私とはカフェなどです。
dialogue.English: With me, we go to cafes and such.

dialogue.content: 私がコーヒー好きなので付き合ってくれます
dialogue.English: She humors me because I like coffee.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは素敵ですね。娘さんはお母様に甘えられているのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's lovely. It sounds like your daughter feels comfortable being dependent on you.

dialogue.content: 先ほど心配していた買い物依存症など、娘さんをあなたがよく見ているので、そういった兆候などあれば変化に気付けて対応できるのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Regarding the shopping addiction you were worried about earlier, since you observe your daughter so well, don't you think you would be able to notice any changes or signs and respond accordingly?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！二人で楽しくお茶できる時は確かに落ちついています。買い物代わりになっているんだと思います。
dialogue.English: Thank you! When the two of us can enjoy tea together, she is indeed calmer. I think it serves as a substitute for shopping.

dialogue.content: すでに依存気味なのでは？と感じて心配しております。今のような対応で良いのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I worry that she may already be somewhat dependent. Is it okay to continue responding as I have been?

dialogue.content: またカフェなどについても気に行ったお店じゃない時はイライラして、買い物しないと気が済まない…感じになります。。
dialogue.English: Also, even with cafes, if it’s not a place she likes, she gets irritated and feels she won’t be satisfied unless she goes shopping…

dialogue.content: そう感じているのですね。あなたは娘さんとよくコミニュケーションもとれています。二人で行動もしているし、対応もよくできていると感じます。年頃の娘さんなので感情の波があっても自然なことだと感じます。どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: I see that's how you feel. You communicate well with your daughter. You do things together, and I feel you handle situations well. Since she's a teenage girl, I feel it's natural for her to have emotional ups and downs. What are your thoughts on that?

dialogue.content: そう言われてみると、確かにそうなのかもしれないですね。ちょっと幼く、難しい娘ですが私の理想が高いのかもしれないですね！
dialogue.English: Now that you mention it, that might be true. She's a bit immature and difficult, but maybe my expectations are just too high!

dialogue.content: 気付かせていただいてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for helping me realize that.

dialogue.content: バイト代も全て使ってますが借金まではしないので、まだいいのかもしれません
dialogue.English: She does spend all of her part-time job money, but she doesn't go into debt, so maybe that's still okay.

dialogue.content: 買い物以外に落ち着く物、ことを探したいと思ってしまうのですが
dialogue.English: I can't help but want to find something else that calms her down besides shopping, though.

dialogue.content: その点も私の理想が高いでしょうか？？
dialogue.English: Are my expectations too high in that regard as well?

dialogue.content: そう感じられたのですね。大切な娘さんなので、もっとこうあってほしいと思うのは当然だと思います。あなたは娘さんの買い物のことでご相談にきました。ここでお話されて今はどう感じていますか？
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. She is your precious daughter, so it's natural to wish for her to be a certain way. You came here to discuss your daughter's shopping. Having talked about it, how are you feeling now?

dialogue.content: そうですね…気持ちの波は自然なことと言っていただき、少しはそんなものかな？と思えました。その波が買い物しなきゃ、、となっている感じなので
dialogue.English: Well... Hearing you say that emotional fluctuations are natural has made me think that perhaps that's just how it is. It feels like those fluctuations are what's turning into the compulsion, 'I have to shop...'

dialogue.content: 浪費は気になりますが
dialogue.English: The overspending does concern me, though.

dialogue.content: 今はこのままで良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay to leave things as they are for now?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。借金もなくある範囲の中でやれています。あなたは温かく見守りながら、よく見れていると感じます。一緒にカフェや買い物で仲もいいですし、なによりもあなたはしっかりと娘さんを見ています。そのことに安心してもいいのではないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. She isn't in debt and is managing within her means. I feel that you are watching over her warmly and observing her well. You get along well, going to cafes and shopping together, and above all, you are truly seeing your daughter. Isn't it okay to feel reassured by that?

dialogue.content: なるほど、心配より娘と出来ていることを見た方が良いですね！！
dialogue.English: I see. It's better to look at what we're able to do together, rather than just worrying!

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですね！一気にモヤモヤが減りました
dialogue.English: That's certainly true! The haze in my mind has lifted all at once.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: そう感じたのですね。年頃の娘さんと仲がよく、羨ましいと感じます。こんなにもよく状況を把握できているので、これからも心配ないのかと感じます。それはあなたがそばにいるからです。今日はここでご相談を終了したいと思いますが、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad you feel that way. I think it's wonderful that you get along so well with your teenage daughter. Since you have such a good grasp of the situation, I feel there's no need to worry going forward. That's because you are there by her side. I would like to conclude our session here for today, if that's alright with you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます！！別の見方をしていただき、視野が広がりました！ありがとうございました✨
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you!! You offered me a different perspective, and my outlook has broadened! Thank you so much. ✨

dialogue.content: 終了で大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's fine to end the session.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。では終了致します。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time today. I will now end the session.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: （お疲れ様でした。ありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you again for everything!)

dialogue.content: （貴重なお時間ありがとうございました。それでは終了メッセージ流します。評価よりアドバイスお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your valuable time. I will now send the closing message. Please provide advice rather than a rating.)
